mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, workshop_id, task_type_enum, hierarchy_type, process_id, inspect_type, first_inspect_rate, inspect_method
mapper.select: SELECT ul.team_id, ul.user_name FROM mes_inspect_config c LEFT JOIN mes_inspect_config_team_link tl ON c.id = tl.inspect_config_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link ul on tl.team_id = ul.team_id and ul.bool_leader_enum = 1 LEFT JOIN mes_inspect_config_user_link cul on c.id = cul.inspect_config_id WHERE c.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tl.bool_delete_enum = 0 and ul.bool_delete_enum = 0 and c.status = 1 and cul.inspect_user_id = #{inpectUserid}

SELECT con.* FROM mes_inspect_config con LEFT JOIN mes_inspect_config_team_link ctlink ON con.id = ctlink.inspect_config_id AND ctlink.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_inspect_classification_config_link cclink ON con.id = cclink.inspect_config_id AND cclink.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE con.bool_delete_enum = 0 and con.status = 1 AND con.workshop_id = #{workshopId} AND con.process_id = #{processId} AND ctlink.team_id = #{teamId} AND cclink.classification_id = #{classId}

SELECT con.* FROM mes_inspect_config con LEFT JOIN mes_inspect_classification_config_link cclink ON con.id = cclink.inspect_config_id AND cclink.bool_delete_enum = 0 Left Join mes_inspect_config_user_link cul ON con.id = cul.inspect_config_id WHERE con.bool_delete_enum = 0 and con.status = 1 AND con.workshop_id = #{workshopId} AND con.process_id = #{processId} AND cul.inspect_user_id = #{userId} AND cclink.classification_id = #{classId}

SELECT con.id, con.process_id, ctlink.team_id, cclink.classification_id FROM mes_inspect_config con LEFT JOIN mes_inspect_config_team_link ctlink ON con.id = ctlink.inspect_config_id AND ctlink.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_inspect_classification_config_link cclink ON con.id = cclink.inspect_config_id AND cclink.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE con.bool_delete_enum = 0 and con.status = 1
